answer: Signal Decay Reputation: each new identity starts at zero and must wander through real interactions to gain weight; unused accounts lose standing like an ember fading. A trusted beacon (any high-score node) can temporarily amplify a newcomer, but that amplification decays too. Attacker cost: every fake identity needs sustained genuine activity or paid beacons, so scaling to N sybils costs N times the ongoing participation rent, not a one-time fee.
